HBRGOSAKIMOD-NUMERIC_VALUE.hover.desc: Click the percentage to edit it. Enter or leaving the field saves; Esc cancels. Range: 0–1000%.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-MOD_U_I.title: ModUI
HBRGOSAKIMOD-MOD_U_I.hover.desc: Enable the global HUD layout: vertical potions; gold, room, floor and boss information near tama; HP/DP in the top bar; character powers wrap beside DP without covering gold. Disable to restore the original layout.
Use Big Dog Chew! card art
Displays Additional Shot as Big Dog Chew! with alternate card art.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-FORCE_MOD_ELITE_BOSS_ENCOUN: Always selects this mod's elite encounter when one exists in the current elite pool. Does not affect bosses.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-FORCE_MOD_BOSS_ENCOUNTERS.h: Always selects this mod's boss when one exists in the current boss pool.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_SHEL: Enemy High-Dimensional Shell as a percentage of maximum HP. At Ascension 10, the calculated amount is multiplied by 1.5.
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_DP_GROWTH_PER_ACT_PER: DP is calculated from adjusted maximum HP and the shell percentage, then multiplied per act. Act 1 has no extra growth. At 20%: Act 2 is ×1.2, Act 3 is ×1.44, then ×1.2 again each act.
Enemy DP growth per act (exact value)
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_MAX_HP_PERCENT.title: Enemy maximum HP multiplier
Percentage of the enemy's original maximum HP. 100% keeps the original value. Adjusted HP has a minimum of 1, including at 0%.
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above. HP has a minimum of 1.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_MAX_HP_GROWTH_PER_ACT: Enemy maximum HP growth per act
Compounds on the maximum HP multiplier each act. Act 1 has no extra growth. At 20%: Act 2 is ×1.2, Act 3 is ×1.44, then ×1.2 again each act. HP has a minimum of 1.
Enemy maximum HP growth per act (exact value)
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_DAMAGE_PERCENT.title: Enemy damage multiplier
Percentage of the enemy's original damage. 100% keeps the original value.
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_DAMAGE_GROWTH_PER_ACT: Compounds on the damage multiplier each act. Act 1 has no extra growth. At 20%: Act 2 is ×1.2, Act 3 is ×1.44, then ×1.2 again each act.
Enemy damage growth per act (exact value)
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
